title: Accounts Assistant
description:
Robert Half are recruiting for an Accounts Assistant on a temporary basis in the Swindon area for 6 months.

Office based 5 days per week.

The day-to-day responsibilities include filing, assisting with accounts administration, vehicles, tax and insurance administration, liaising with branches, compiling payroll information (rather than processing payroll), and general finance administration duties.

There are also several additional administrative tasks involved, such as uniform distribution, stationery ordering, fuel card administration, and other ad hoc duties as required.

Given that the role sits across both HR and Finance functions, this is quite a varied role.
- Managing incoming emails and acting as a key point of contact
- Handling inbound and outbound phone calls
- Issuing invoices, credits, and statements to customers in line with requests
- Accounts such as journals, fixed assets management
- Processing timesheets every Monday
- Chasing Business Managers for outstanding timesheets
- Monitoring and maintaining vehicle MOTs and road tax (fortnightly checks)
- Completing mileage and expense claims
- Maintaining compliance checklists
- Updating branch registers (e.g. key holders, utilities)
- Managing uniform orders and stock
- Processing Return to Work forms
- Maintaining employee records (electronic and hard copy filing)
- Supporting ONS (Office for National Statistics) requests (as required

title: Accounts Payable Assistant
description:
Accounts Payable Assistant (Part-Time)

Location: Corsham
Salary: £28,000 - £30,000 per annum (Full-Time Equivalent)
Job Type: Part-time, Permanent
Working Hours: 25 hours per week - Monday - Friday (flexible on start and finish times) OR 3 full days per week

We are currently recruiting for a part-time Accounts Payable Assistant to join a growing and innovative business based in Corsham

The position is offered on a part-time basis, with flexibility around how the hours are worked. Whether you are looking for school-friendly hours across five days or prefer to work hours over 3 days.

As part of a smaller, growing business, a flexible and hands-on approach is important, with the opportunity to assist with wider office duties when required.

Key Responsibilities
- Managing the accounts payable inbox and responding to relevant queries.
- Uploading, registering and coding supplier invoices onto the finance system.
- Processing invoices and matching them against purchase orders.
- Processing employee expenses and ensuring records are maintained accurately.
- Preparing weekly supplier payment runs for management approval.
- Processing one-off supplier payments as required.
- Raising purchase orders relating to intercompany recharges.
- Completing supplier statement reconciliations and intercompany reconciliations.
- Carrying out bank reconciliations.
- Liaising with suppliers, contractors, consultants and internal colleagues to resolve queries.
- Providing general finance and administrative support as required.
- Providing support to other areas of the business during quieter periods e.g. assisting on reception if required
- Adopting a flexible, hands-on approach to supporting the wider team.

We are looking for someone with previous accounts payable and purchase ledger experience who takes pride in producing accurate work and keeping financial records organised.

The ideal candidate will have:
- Previous experience in an Accounts Payable and Purchase Ledger - essential
- Excellent attention to detail and a strong focus on accuracy.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to prioritise workload effectively.
- Confident communication skills, particularly when dealing with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- The ability to work independently

Desirable:
- Experience using Xero accounting software.
- Familiarity with ApprovalMax.
- Knowledge of Airwallex payment systems.

title: Bookkeeper/Payroll
description:
This bookkeeping and payroll role in Marlborough is all about keeping financial records accurate and organised while ensuring smooth payroll management. It's a key position in the professional services industry that helps the business maintain efficient financial operations.

Client Details

This professional services company is based in Marlborough and operates within the accounting and finance sector.

Description
- Manage daily bookkeeping tasks to maintain accurate financial records.
- Process payroll efficiently and ensure compliance with relevant regulations.
- Reconcile accounts and resolve discrepancies promptly.
- Prepare financial reports and support month-end processes.
- Handle VAT submissions and other statutory requirements.
- Collaborate with colleagues to streamline accounting processes.
- Maintain confidentiality and security of financial data.
- Respond to client queries related to payroll and bookkeeping.

Profile

A successful Bookkeeper/Payroll professional should have:
- Strong bookkeeping and payroll management skills.
- Experience with accounting software and tools.
- A solid understanding of VAT and statutory requirements.
- Attention to detail and excellent organisational skills.
- The ability to work independently and meet deadlines.
- Good communication skills for client and team interactions.

Job Offer
- Salary between £30,000 and £32,000 dependent on the level of experience.
- Hybrid working arrangement for better work-life balance.
- Permanent position within the professional services industry.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Credit Control Administrator
description:
We are seeking a proactive and organised Credit Control Administrator to join a busy Finance team in a hybrid working environment based in Swindon. This is an excellent opportunity for an individual with strong administration skills and an interest in finance to develop their career within a supportive and collaborative team. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting credit control activities, maintaining strong stakeholder relationships, and ensuring the smooth running of day-to-day finance operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and respond to incoming credit control enquiries via telephone and email.
- Monitor and maintain the central credit control mailbox, ensuring all queries are actioned promptly.
- Take ownership of customer instalment plans, ensuring agreed payment arrangements are adhered to.
- Chase outstanding low-value debts and assist with debt recovery activities.
- Process client card payments in line with company policies and procedures.
- Produce and distribute scheduled monthly reports.
- Complete new supplier/vendor documentation and administration.
- Support clients and internal stakeholders with requests for copy invoices, statements, and billing-related queries.
- Provide general administrative support to the wider finance team as required.
- Undertake additional duties as requested by senior finance management.

Experience & Knowledge
- We are looking for someone who is highly organised, detail-oriented and enjoys working in a fast-paced environment.
- Previous experience working within a finance or accounts environment.
- Credit control experience is advantageous but not essential.
- Strong administration experience.
- Basic knowledge or understanding of finance and accounting processes.
- Confident using IT systems and able to adapt quickly to new software and processes.

Skills & Attributes
- Excellent time management and organisational skills.
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to identify problems and implement practical solutions.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Professional and confident approach when dealing with stakeholders at all levels.
- Able to work independently whilst also contributing positively as part of a team.
- Takes ownership of responsibilities and follows tasks through to completion.
- Open, honest, and eager to learn and develop professionally.

This is an integral role for our client, and they are looking to interview people as soon as possible. If you are interested in this role and would like to hear more and potentially be submitted, please apply now and we can arrange a call.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Robert Half are working in partnership with a continuously growing, forward-thinking business near Chippenham to recruit a Credit Controller on a full-time permanent basis. The Credit Controller role is a great opportunity for an experienced individual that is keen to add value with credit control expertise, build strong business relationships and take ownership of a range of key credit control related tasks. The salary is between £30,000 - £35,000 plus hybrid working and other excellent benefits.

The Role

The main duties of the Credit Controller role will consist of:
- Chasing outstanding debt by phone and email
- Managing collections across a range of accounts
- Investigating and resolve invoice disputes and delayed payments
- Reviewing aged debt and support reduction of overdue balances
- Allocating daily cash receipts
- Reconciling payments and resolve unallocated cash
- Resolving payment queries
- Maintaining account information

Requirements

To be considered for the Credit Controller role, you must ideally have the following experience/skills:
- Must have experience in Credit Control and Accounts Receivable
- Excellent attention to detail
- Strong organisational skills
- Good Excel skills
- Strong communication negotiation skills
- Healthcare or NHS experience desirable
- Good team player

Salary & Benefits
- £30,000 - £35,000 annual salary
- Hybrid working; 3 days on site, 2 days from home
- 25 days annual leave + bank holidays
- Pension scheme
- Life insurance
- On site parking

title: Italian or French Speaking Accounts Receivable Credit Controller
description:
FRENCH SELECTION (FS)

Italian or French Speaking Accounts Receivable Credit Controller

Location: Swindon

Salary: £30,000 - £35,000 per annum, depending on experience

Ref: 795 AR

To apply using our preferred format, please visit the French Selection website, go to the vacancies page and search job reference: 795 AR.

The company:

An international organisation with an established European Shared Service Centre, supporting multiple locations across Europe.

Main duties:

Managing Accounts Receivable and Credit Control activities for the Italian market, including customer collections, credit risk assessment, financial reporting, reconciliations and month-end processes.

The role:

Managing the Italian Accounts Receivable ledger and customer collections across four locations.

Monitoring outstanding invoices and overdue payments to minimise aged debt and improve cash flow.

Setting up new customer accounts and assessing credit risks, including reviewing and allocating credit limits.

Organising regular debtor ageing meetings with Customer Service, Sales and Finance teams to review accounts and resolve outstanding queries.

Preparing weekly Accounts Receivable reports, including debtor balances and actual and projected bad debt.

Managing month-end closing activities and completing Accounts Receivable and General Ledger reconciliations.

Preparing and processing weekly General Ledger uploads.

Collaborating with colleagues across the European Shared Service Centre and other internal departments.

Initially working office-based during the training period.

The candidate:

Fluent in Italian or French, with Italian particularly desirable.

Previous experience in Accounts Receivable, Credit Control or Collections.

Good understanding of credit management, debt recovery and credit risk assessment.

Experience managing customer accounts, resolving payment queries and reducing overdue debt.

Strong communication and customer relationship management skills.

Good Excel skills and confidence working with financial data and reporting.

Experience using accounting or ERP systems.

Previous experience within an international organisation or Shared Service Centre would be advantageous.

Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.

A proactive approach with the ability to build effective relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

The salary: £30,000 - £35,000 per annum, depending on experience

French Selection, leading UK-based consultancy specialising in the recruitment of bilingual and multilingual professionals for international business (industries and services). We are the leading recruitment consultancy for German, French, Italian and Spanish speaking positions. Also recruiting for positions with other languages such as Dutch, Polish, Portuguese, Scandinavian languages, Mandarin, Japanese and Arabic.

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk
description:
Robert Half are recruiting for an Accounts Payable Assistant to be based in Swindon on a temporary basis.

Immediate Start - Office based in Swindon.

We are recruiting for an Accounts Payable Assistant with SAP skills to join a busy finance team in Swindon on a 3-month temporary contract.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a solid background in SAP invoice processing, supplier reconciliations, and payment runs, who can hit the ground running in a fast-paced finance environment.

The Role

As an Accounts Payable Assistant, you will play a key role in ensuring supplier invoices are processed accurately and payments are made on time via SAP.

You will work closely with suppliers, procurement teams, and internal stakeholders to maintain efficient financial operations and support continuous process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

Receive, review and process supplier invoices in line with company policies and procedures

Ensure all invoices are correctly authorised and coded prior to payment

Prepare and review payment runs, investigating exceptions and ensuring credit notes are applied appropriately Produce and maintain aged creditor reports

Reconcile supplier statements and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner

Process cheque requests for customer refunds,

Ensure appropriate supporting documentation and approvals are in place for one-time suppliers

Work closely with Procurement to maintain accurate supplier records

Build strong working relationships with suppliers and internal stakeholders

Support improvements to Accounts Payable processes and systems

To be successful in this role, you will have:

Previous Accounts Payable / Purchase Ledger experience

Strong SAP experience is essential

Experience processing high volumes of supplier invoices

Strong supplier reconciliation and query resolution skills

Good knowledge of payment run processes

Excellent attention to detail and accuracy Competent Excel skills

Strong communication skills and a professional approach when dealing with stakeholders

title: Purchase Ledger Clerk / Finance Administrator
description:
About the company

Our client is a modern, forward-thinking business based in Chippenham. They're growing, they invest in their people and systems, and they want a finance team that is efficient and also looking for better ways to work. This is a chance to join a supportive team where your ideas will be heard and your work will make a visible difference.

The role

As Purchase Ledger Clerk / Finance Administrator, you'll keep the purchase ledger accurate and up to date and support the wider finance function day to day. The work is varied and hands-on, so it would suit someone who likes structure and is happy to help wherever it's needed.

Key responsibilities
- Processing supplier invoices and credit notes accurately and on time
- Matching invoices to purchase orders and resolving discrepancies
- Preparing and processing weekly or monthly supplier payment runs
- Reconciling supplier statements and dealing with supplier queries
- Maintaining supplier records and the purchase ledger
- Processing expense claims and company card transactions
- Supporting month-end tasks, including accruals and reconciliations
- General finance administration, filing and ad hoc support to the finance team

About you
- Previous experience in a purchase ledger, accounts payable or finance admin role
- Good working knowledge of accounting software (e.g. Xero, Sage, QuickBooks or similar)
- Confident with Excel
- Organised, accurate and good with detail
- A clear communicator, comfortable dealing with suppliers and colleagues
- Proactive and open to new systems and ways of working
- AAT studies (part or fully qualified) would be an advantage but aren't essential

What's on offer
- Salary of £30,000 - £40,000, depending on experience
- A modern, friendly working environment
- Opportunities to develop your skills and grow with the business
